## Executive Summary
Naboraj Sarkar is a Systems Architect, AI Engineer, and ICSE-trained tech innovator operating out of India under the personal brand **NS CODEX**. His primary mission is empowering India and global learners with **free, high-quality coding education** while building zero-latency enterprise systems, intelligent automation agents, 3D spatial web applications, and participating in crypto asset management.

### 1. Enterprise Logic (Systems Architecture)

### 2. Intelligent Bots (AI Automation)
- **Focus**: Neuro-mimetic automation for Telegram, WhatsApp, and CRM infrastructure.
- **Tech Stack**: Python, OpenAI API, Webhooks, Node-RED, Custom LLM Pipelines.

### 3. Spatial Experiences (3D & Interactive Web)
- **Focus**: Immersive web portals using physics-driven liquid glass and 3D graphics.

### 4. Global Pipeline (Integration & Automation)
- **Focus**: Unifying marketing tools, payment processing, and logistics systems.
- **Tech Stack**: Node-RED, Stripe API, REST/GraphQL APIs, CRM Systems.
- **Value**: Eliminates manual friction for agencies and creator businesses.

### 5. Security Forge (Cybersecurity & Infrastructure)
- **Focus**: Hardening web assets, end-to-end encryption, network edge firewalls.
- **Tech Stack**: TLS/SSL, Cybersecurity Best Practices, Linux Infrastructure.
- **Value**: Complete data integrity and threat mitigation.

### 6. Mobile Synapse (Mobile Application Development)
- **Focus**: Native-feel mobile apps with fluid 60fps interaction and offline storage.
- **Tech Stack**: Flutter, Swift, Kotlin, React Native.
- **Value**: Portable, high-speed mobile software.
